references.title: LiveBench: A Challenging, Contamination-Limited LLM Benchmark
references.use: Fresh sources and continually renewed objective scoring reduce contamination exposure. Use accepted conference title Contamination-Limited rather than overclaim zero risk from earlier arXiv title.
